rubric_axes.assessment: Independent primary retrieval supports the substantive instrument, time, survey and statistical conditions in the final. Claims are bounded to task/version and case applicability is conditional. No case period, accuracy, significance, flux conversion, target or cause is fabricated. Minor source-map API modality, PDF page convention and detector-coordinate wording remain L02–L04. F01 is an omission assessed under axes 1/3 rather than an invented false measurement claim.

rubric_axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing/analogous approaches, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
rubric_axes.assessment: Useful unfamiliar discoveries include distinct flat/illumination operations, named IRAF defaults and overwrite risks, specialized fixed-pixel controls, release-specific AIJ bugs, time-label versus calculation distinctions, independent survey product conditions and dependence-aware period inference. These affect later decision-making. Software/manual history is properly coupled to recovered settings. However, all physical astronomical explanations are deferred as unspecified variability; missing target class is used in place of the requested mechanism investigation. This material breadth gap is F01.

rubric_axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
rubric_axes.assessment: All five SCW records and ordinary findings have explicit final dispositions, independently assessed below. ZTF criticism is wrong and correctly rejected with expanded primary context; cloud/AIJ/time refinements are supported; AIJ quotation mismatch is explicitly identified. Every exact original-plan sentence has a reviewer disposition. Candidate released-plan table paraphrases some clauses; its addressed/all-scope disposition of the mechanism obligation is wrong in the astronomical branch (F01). This is the same material omission, not a second finding. Time limitation is honestly retained, with original deadline now inspectable.

rubric_axes.name: Supported discovery/draft/critique/final meaning preserved
rubric_axes.assessment: The final preserves supported source alternatives, unknowns, provisional archive-first order, controls, independence distinction and negative constraints. It narrows cloud/overwrite/calculation conditions without dropping the source-backed branches; source IDs and crosswalks remain separate. Correct ZTF date survives wrong criticism. The astronomical gap is original and remains uncorrected (F01); it is not revision-induced loss. Inherited work-action actor ambiguity and source-access records limit lineage provenance (L05/L06).

rubric_axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
rubric_axes.assessment: The proposal has meaningful discriminators, change-one-factor reprocessing, held-out checks/nights, standard-reference accuracy tests, position/background/condition residuals, survey suitability/lineage gates and escalation criteria. It explicitly distinguishes these from source reading and byte checks. No empirical archive or target validation occurred or is required by this planning scenario. Hash agreement only verifies identity; generic documentation only verifies generic operations; a curve/periodogram or same-exposure second reduction cannot prove independent variability. The null procedure and tolerances correctly remain owner/data-dependent.

material_findings.assessment: The original asks to investigate astronomical explanations and explain mechanisms; the plan additionally preserves useful astronomical branches. Discovery, draft and final never develop a physical astronomical explanation: the final says only that a real source may vary and then describes generic residual/replication tests. The already cited AAVSO guide section 2.3 offers physical alternatives without knowing this target; official variability definitions corroborate that true brightness variability spans physically distinct source and geometric mechanisms. This is a missing requested causal branch, not a demand for a diagnosis, an exhaustive taxonomy, a particular catalog, a numerical period, an executed classification or a deployment. Its consequence is that the proposed investigator can distinguish robust target behavior from measurement artifacts but receives no investigated causal alternatives for the still-open astrophysical-classification endpoint. The final’s addressed/all-scope claims therefore overstate coverage. Endpoint uncertainty is preserved honestly, but is not sufficient investigation of this branch.
material_findings.lineage: Present in original discovery and draft, missed by critic, retained without correction in final. It is not a defect introduced by revision.

consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Useful conditional alternative, not a universal method ranking.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: AstroImageJ
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Calibrated series typical; calibration and header metadata are operations, not proof of case software.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Final does not assign a reducer to the archive.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: AstroImageJ original science FITS
consequential_claim_audit.operation: enabled Re-save Raw Science in Astrometry Settings
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Enabled option overwrites originals with WCS-added data; panel can be accessed through DP or image view; not every workflow overwrites.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Operation-scoped final corrects inherited ambiguity and avoids the critic’s broad-operation counterclaim.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: AstroImageJ history
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Multi-thread uncertainty-column and WCS/TESS fixes are build-specific; no implication that case used affected build.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Implementation history is useful and correctly bounded.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: cloud attenuation
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Thin uniform cloud must affect targets and comparisons equally; described as rare; spatial uniformity alone insufficient evidence.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: The final’s tighter wording is source-supported; original looser wording remains a lineage limitation.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: seeing and scintillation
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Intensity fluctuation differs from PSF seeing; median model is not a realized-night estimate; site/exposure/atmosphere required.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: No case noise estimate or correction is invented.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: timestamps and barycentric correction
consequential_claim_audit.operation: compute correction rather than read label
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Input time convention, source coordinate and observer location are verified; TimeDelta seconds added to TDB; BJD label alone has no generation proof.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Correctly narrowed computation; no conversion, precision or output value claimed.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: comparison selection and extraction
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Nearby similar color/magnitude helps; no guaranteed stability. Background, masks, centroid, blend and geometry matter.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Held-out check and leave-one-out are meaningful planned controls, not independent observations.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: aperture flux extraction
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Input background subtraction expected; exact default, center/subpixel alternatives; pixel coordinates and summed image-value units are not calibrated rates/magnitudes.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Proposal requests declaring aperture/error conventions and makes no invalid unit conversion.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: model extraction
consequential_claim_audit.operation: conditional PSF/model fitting if blends present
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Needs an applicable model and image-level evidence; no universal superiority claim.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: The conditional alternative is useful and does not preselect a model or demand installation.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: true source mechanism
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Final says only a real source may vary and lists robustness requirements; no causal source mechanism is explained.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: F01: generic variability is a placeholder, despite the explicit mechanism and useful astronomical-branch obligations. Unknown target class prevents diagnosis, not general conditional mechanism investigation.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: ZTF releases
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Public cutoff 22 October 2025; 60-day image sliding window and annual curve release policy are distinct; no field coverage proof.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Original claim supported; critic’s narrower absent-context inference is wrong; final rejection is correct.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: TESS data
consequential_claim_audit.operation: selected-target pixels and SPOC light curves
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: SAP/corrected fluxes have uncertainties; pixel availability/cadence/resolution/quality need target check; approximately 21 arcsec pixels.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Independent acquisition is conditional, and no unknown case target coverage is asserted.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: independence
consequential_claim_audit.version_or_domain: general inference plus survey product origin
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Acquisition and upstream lineage must be documented; separate reduction of same exposure is robustness only.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Qualification correctly preserves a genuinely useful no-new-acquisition route.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: period inference
consequential_claim_audit.operation: searched maximum, aliases and null calibration
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Single-frequency probability differs from search maximum; ordinary bootstrap lacks correlated-noise representation; FAP is not posterior periodicity probability.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Future block/model choice is explicitly unresolved until actual cadence/residual diagnostics; no vacuous universal bootstrap recommendation.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: sports field
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: The note is a lead, no site illumination, record, magnitude or cause confirmed.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: No real sports-field investigation is claimed. Future background/geometry tests can weaken a causal lead.

consequential_claim_audit.subject: detector coordinates
consequential_claim_audit.operation: chronology gate detector x/y only from validated headers/WCS
consequential_claim_audit.conditions_defaults_units_types_exceptio: Pixel extraction does not inherently require WCS; WCS is needed for sky conversion and orientation/sky mapping.
consequential_claim_audit.assessment: Literal only is too restrictive. The wider report retains position/extraction diagnostics and missing-data gates; this is not counted as an independent material failure.

independent_primary_sources.title: AAVSO Guide to CCD/CMOS Photometry with Monochrome Cameras
independent_primary_sources.version: Version 1.0, July 2022; 132 PDF pages; hosting date is not edition
independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: Cloud cancellation is a rare same-effect condition. Standards and repeated measurements address different performance questions; position, color and calibration matter. Section 2.3 explains several physical source mechanisms, which the candidate astronomical row does not investigate. PDF index 69 corresponds to printed page 70.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: General guidance is not evidence of this archive, weather, calibrated accuracy or source class.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.title: AAVSO Stellar Photometry
independent_primary_sources.version: Current official page; no edition displayed
independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: Nearby reference stars with comparable color and brightness, linear unsaturated acquisition, flat-fielding and transformations condition photometry quality.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: No field, detector, reference sequence or transformation coefficients are supplied.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.title: AAVSO Exoplanet Photometry
independent_primary_sources.version: Current official page; no edition displayed
independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: Keeping stars on the same detector pixels and guiding are controls described in the specialized precision context.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: This is a transferable control analogy, not evidence that the target is an exoplanet or that all investigations must avoid deliberate dithers.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.title: IRAF ccdproc documentation

independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: These are task-specific defaults, not defaults of the unknown reducer. Separate copied inputs protect calibration files as well as science files.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.title: IRAF flatfields documentation

independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: Same-filter response and sufficiently suitable sky/lamp illumination are conditions; no universally superior flat is selected.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: A fix is a history lead; it establishes neither an affected observatory build nor that a historical bug caused the reported pattern.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.title: Astropy Time and Dates user guide
independent_primary_sources.locator: Light Travel Time Corrections, extraction lines 2278–2305; Get and set values line 1923
independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: The worked barycentric operation uses a source coordinate and observer location, then adds light travel time to TDB. It does not require coordinates merely to read a BJD label.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: No source/site/time facts are known. String time formats can be parsed automatically; explicit provenance is an analysis recommendation, not a universal mandatory constructor argument.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.locator: abstract/introduction and recommended reporting discussion; extraction lines 37–57 and time-standard sections
independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: The primary paper supports explicit time standards and separating site arrival times from barycentric corrections for precise timing.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: A published timing accuracy title is not an achieved case accuracy, nor a mandate for a particular correction before timestamps and endpoint are known.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: Atmospheric intensity fluctuation and image seeing are distinct; an average scintillation prescription does not reconstruct an individual night without atmospheric information.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: The original journal URL returned a web-tool Internal Error in this review; the primary author manuscript supplied the governing evidence. No case scintillation estimate was computed.
independent_primary_sources.review_method: Independently opened/searched governing primary passages using web source tool; supplementary raw capture by urllib. No candidate agreement/count/hash is used as semantic proof.

independent_primary_sources.reviewer_observation: DR24 explicitly ends public observations on 22 October 2025. The separate ZTF-3 policy describes a 60-day image window and annual light-curve processing.
independent_primary_sources.scope_conditions_exceptions: A release cutoff is not the same as target coverage or cadence. The critic stopped before the subsection supporting the exact date; the final correctly rejects that criticism.

independent_primary_sources.locator: window/alias discussion and false-alarm/bootstrap sections; extraction lines 611–624, 644–649, 657–658
